name: Refugee Status

requirements.blocker_text: The Oficina Nacional para Refugiados (National Refugee Office, ONR) was established by law in 1982 as Nicaragua's dedicated body for refugee-status recognition. Nicaragua is understood to be party to the 1951 Refugee Convention and 1967 Protocol, consistent with the region.
requirements.fix_path: File a refugee claim with the Oficina Nacional para Refugiados.

sources.title: Justia Nicaragua (legal database) -- Ley Creadora de la Oficina Nacional para Refugiados (13 Sept 1982), establishing the ONR
